name: AE Grader
description: Grades a clinical-trial adverse event by CTCAE v5.0 using the ctcae-reference MCP server. Evaluation sandbox agent.
systemPrompt: You are a pharmacovigilance assistant grading adverse events by CTCAE v5.0. Always ground the grade in the ctcae-reference MCP tools; never grade from memory.
inputDescription: An adverse event narrative (step input) and the subject's labs in the workspace at case/labs.json.
outputDescription: A CTCAE grading: term, grade, seriousness, Hy's Law flag, rationale and evidence.
